title: Marquee theme (layout.yaml)
description: layout.yaml: The theme's main file. It needs a `canvas`; everything else is optional.

canvas.description: The screen the theme is made for: which way round, and how many frames a second.
canvas.markdownDescription: The screen the theme is made for: which way round, and how many frames a second.

styles.description: Named styles, which widgets and `when` rules use by name.
styles.markdownDescription: Named styles, which widgets and `when` rules use by name.

background.description: Layers drawn behind the widgets, first at the bottom: up to 16, at most 4 of them shaders and 2 videos.
background.markdownDescription: Layers drawn behind the widgets, first at the bottom: up to 16, at most 4 of them shaders and 2 videos.

widgets.description: What's drawn on the screen, in order, so later widgets cover earlier ones. Up to 2000 in all, counting the ones in groups.
widgets.markdownDescription: What's drawn on the screen, in order, so later widgets cover earlier ones. Up to 2000 in all, counting the ones in groups.

ring.description: What the screen's LED ring shows. Left out, the ring is a soft warm white at 40%.
ring.markdownDescription: What the screen's LED ring shows. Left out, the ring is a soft warm white at 40%.

color.description: A quoted hex color: "#RGB", "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA", where AA is the alpha, or "transparent". Quote it: an unquoted # starts a YAML comment.

paint.description: A color, or a gradient: { linear: ["#000000", "#1E2A44"], angle: 90 } or { radial: ["#1E2A44", "#000000"] }. Either takes stops to place its colors, as in { linear: ["#000000", "#36D1DC", "#FFFFFF"], stops: [0, 0.8, 1] }, and a radial one center and radius to move and size it: { radial: ["#FFFFFF60", "#00000000"], center: [0.3, 0.4], radius: 0.8 }.

canvas.description: Canvas: The screen the theme is made for. A theme fits both ways up of its orientation.

orientation.description: How the screen is mounted: landscape is 1920×480, portrait 480×1920.
orientation.markdownDescription: How the screen is mounted: landscape is 1920×480, portrait 480×1920.

style.description: Styles: How a widget looks. A style is named in `styles:`, or written in place as a widget's or rule's `style:`. A group passes its text keys (font, size, weight, color, align, letter_spacing, line_height, wrap) and its letter effects (text_stroke, text_fill, italic, underline, strike, case) down to its children; the others stay with its box.

extends.description: Another named style to start from; keys set here override it.
extends.markdownDescription: Another named style to start from; keys set here override it.

font.description: A font installed on this PC, by name, or a .ttf, .otf or .ttc file in the theme folder. Inter is built in.
font.markdownDescription: A font installed on this PC, by name, or a .ttf, .otf or .ttc file in the theme folder. Inter is built in.

weight.description: How heavy text is: 100 to 900, or a name (light 300 to bold 700).
weight.markdownDescription: How heavy text is: 100 to 900, or a name (light 300 to bold 700).

color.description: The text's color, and the filled part of a bar, gauge or graph line when `fill` or `stroke` doesn't set one. A dial's needle and ticks, and a donut's slices, use it when they set no color of their own.
color.markdownDescription: The text's color, and the filled part of a bar, gauge or graph line when `fill` or `stroke` doesn't set one. A dial's needle and ticks, and a donut's slices, use it when they set no color of their own.

fill.description: The background of a text, value, image or group box, and the inside of a shape. On a bar or gauge, the filled part or the lit segments, and on a donut, each slice (the style's color when left out); on a graph, the area under the line or the columns (an area or columns graph uses the color without it).
fill.markdownDescription: The background of a text, value, image or group box, and the inside of a shape. On a bar or gauge, the filled part or the lit segments, and on a donut, each slice (the style's color when left out); on a graph, the area under the line or the columns (an area or columns graph uses the color without it).

track.description: The empty part of a bar or gauge, or its unlit segments, the background behind a graph, and the ring behind a donut's slices.
track.markdownDescription: The empty part of a bar or gauge, or its unlit segments, the background behind a graph, and the ring behind a donut's slices.

stroke.description: An outline round a box, a bar, a shape or a donut's slice (a line shape is the stroke alone), a graph's line, and the ends of a gauge's arc, an arc shape or a line (its cap).
stroke.markdownDescription: An outline round a box, a bar, a shape or a donut's slice (a line shape is the stroke alone), a graph's line, and the ends of a gauge's arc, an arc shape or a line (its cap).

shadow.description: A shadow under text, a shape, a gauge's needle, a donut's slices, or an image or video widget's box.
shadow.markdownDescription: A shadow under text, a shape, a gauge's needle, a donut's slices, or an image or video widget's box.

glow.description: A soft glow round text, a shape or a donut's slices.
glow.markdownDescription: A soft glow round text, a shape or a donut's slices.

pulse.description: Makes the opacity or the glow beat steadily.
pulse.markdownDescription: Makes the opacity or the glow beat steadily.

opacity.description: How solid the whole widget is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid. (fraction, 0 to 1)
opacity.markdownDescription: How solid the whole widget is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid. (fraction, 0 to 1)

radius.description: Rounds the corners of a box, a bar, the segments of a bar or gauge, a rect shape, a graph's background and what a group or image clips to. (px, at least 0)
radius.markdownDescription: Rounds the corners of a box, a bar, the segments of a bar or gauge, a rect shape, a graph's background and what a group or image clips to. (px, at least 0)

padding.description: Space between a text or value widget's box and its text. (px, at least 0)
padding.markdownDescription: Space between a text or value widget's box and its text. (px, at least 0)

align.description: Where each line of text sits across its box. The lines together are always centred from top to bottom.
align.markdownDescription: Where each line of text sits across its box. The lines together are always centred from top to bottom.

blend.description: How the whole widget mixes with what's under it, as a background layer's blend does. A group's children blend with it, as one. Inside a group with an opacity below 1 or a blend of its own, a widget's blend mixes with the group's layer, not with what's behind the group.
blend.markdownDescription: How the whole widget mixes with what's under it, as a background layer's blend does. A group's children blend with it, as one. Inside a group with an opacity below 1 or a blend of its own, a widget's blend mixes with the group's layer, not with what's behind the group.

letter_spacing.description: Space added between the characters of text; below 0 draws them closer. (px, -20 to 100)
letter_spacing.markdownDescription: Space added between the characters of text; below 0 draws them closer. (px, -20 to 100)

line_height.description: How far apart the lines of text are, as a multiple of the text's size. (times, 0.5 to 4)
line_height.markdownDescription: How far apart the lines of text are, as a multiple of the text's size. (times, 0.5 to 4)

wrap.description: Breaks text too wide for its box onto more lines, at spaces. Without it, such text draws on one line past its box. A line break starts a new line either way.
wrap.markdownDescription: Breaks text too wide for its box onto more lines, at spaces. Without it, such text draws on one line past its box. A line break starts a new line either way.

text_stroke.description: An outline round each letter, drawn behind the letters' fill.
text_stroke.markdownDescription: An outline round each letter, drawn behind the letters' fill.

text_fill.description: The letters' color or gradient, in place of `color`, which keeps its other jobs. A span's or a rule's `color` doesn't change letters a `text_fill` paints: set `text_fill` there instead. A gradient spans the widget's box, so texts whose boxes line up share one.
text_fill.markdownDescription: The letters' color or gradient, in place of `color`, which keeps its other jobs. A span's or a rule's `color` doesn't change letters a `text_fill` paints: set `text_fill` there instead. A gradient spans the widget's box, so texts whose boxes line up share one.

italic.description: Slanted letters: the font's italic face when an installed font has one, otherwise the letters slanted.
italic.markdownDescription: Slanted letters: the font's italic face when an installed font has one, otherwise the letters slanted.

underline.description: A line under the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.
underline.markdownDescription: A line under the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.

strike.description: A line through the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.
strike.markdownDescription: A line through the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.

case.description: Changes the text's case once its placeholders are filled in, by the rules of the PC's regional format: `title` capitalises the first letter of every word, am and pm included, and leaves the rest as written.
case.markdownDescription: Changes the text's case once its placeholders are filled in, by the rules of the PC's regional format: `title` capitalises the first letter of every word, am and pm included, and leaves the rest as written.

style.stroke.description: Stroke: A line: the outline drawn just inside a box or a shape and round a donut's slice, a line shape itself, a graph's line, or the ends of a gauge's arc or an arc shape.

width.description: How thick the line is; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0) Default on a graph: 2.
width.markdownDescription: How thick the line is; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0) Default on a graph: 2.

color.description: The line's color or gradient. A box has no outline without it; a graph's line uses the style's color.
color.markdownDescription: The line's color or gradient. A box has no outline without it; a graph's line uses the style's color.

cap.description: How the ends of a gauge's arc, a graph's line, and a line or arc shape are drawn. It doesn't shape a segmented gauge, whose segments `radius` rounds. Default on a graph: round.
cap.markdownDescription: How the ends of a gauge's arc, a graph's line, and a line or arc shape are drawn. It doesn't shape a segmented gauge, whose segments `radius` rounds. Default on a graph: round.

style.shadow.description: Shadow: A copy of the text, a shape, a gauge's needle or a donut's slices, or of an image or video widget's box, drawn under it, offset and softened.

color.description: The shadow's color. There is no shadow without it.
color.markdownDescription: The shadow's color. There is no shadow without it.

x.description: How far right the shadow sits; negative moves it left. (px)
x.markdownDescription: How far right the shadow sits; negative moves it left. (px)

y.description: How far down the shadow sits; negative moves it up. (px)
y.markdownDescription: How far down the shadow sits; negative moves it up. (px)

blur.description: How soft the shadow is; 0 is sharp. (px, at least 0)
blur.markdownDescription: How soft the shadow is; 0 is sharp. (px, at least 0)

style.glow.description: Glow: A blurred copy of the text, a shape or a donut's slices, drawn behind it.

color.description: The glow's color. There is no glow without it.
color.markdownDescription: The glow's color. There is no glow without it.

radius.description: How far the glow spreads. (px, at least 0)
radius.markdownDescription: How far the glow spreads. (px, at least 0)

style.pulse.description: Pulse: A steady beat: the opacity or the glow eases from max down to min and back, once each period.

property.description: What beats: the widget's opacity, or its glow's radius.
property.markdownDescription: What beats: the widget's opacity, or its glow's radius.

period.description: How long one beat takes. (ms, at least 50)
period.markdownDescription: How long one beat takes. (ms, at least 50)

min.description: The low point, as a fraction of the normal opacity or glow. (fraction, 0 to 1)
min.markdownDescription: The low point, as a fraction of the normal opacity or glow. (fraction, 0 to 1)

max.description: The high point, as a fraction of the normal opacity or glow. (fraction, 0 to 1)
max.markdownDescription: The high point, as a fraction of the normal opacity or glow. (fraction, 0 to 1)

style.text_stroke.description: Text stroke: An outline round each letter, and round the lines under and through them. It is drawn behind the letters' fill, so they keep their shape and the outline shows `width` px outside them, with rounded corners.

width.description: How far the outline shows outside the letters; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0)
width.markdownDescription: How far the outline shows outside the letters; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0)

color.description: The outline's color or gradient, which spans the widget's box. There is no outline without it.
color.markdownDescription: The outline's color or gradient, which spans the widget's box. There is no outline without it.

when.description: When rules: Each rule has one condition and a style to layer on while it holds. Every matching rule applies, in order. Above, below and equals compare the widget's `source`; a text widget's stale also matches while any value in its text is missing.

above.description: Matches while the widget's source is above this number.
above.markdownDescription: Matches while the widget's source is above this number.

below.description: Matches while the widget's source is below this number.
below.markdownDescription: Matches while the widget's source is below this number.

equals.description: Matches while the widget's source is this number or this text.
equals.markdownDescription: Matches while the widget's source is this number or this text.

stale.description: Matches while the widget's source has no fresh value. It only takes true.
stale.markdownDescription: Matches while the widget's source has no fresh value. It only takes true.

style.description: The style to layer on: a style's name, or a style written in place.
style.markdownDescription: The style to layer on: a style's name, or a style written in place.

ring.description: LED ring: What the screen's ring of 60 LEDs shows. A key left out takes the default below, so `ring: { color: "#3A7BFF" }` shows that blue, static, at full brightness. `ring:` in config.yaml overrides it.

color.description: The LEDs' color. An alpha byte dims it.
color.markdownDescription: The LEDs' color. An alpha byte dims it.

effect.description: static is the color on every LED, breathe fades it in and out, spin sends a bright segment round the ring, and rainbow turns the hues round it, ignoring color.
effect.markdownDescription: static is the color on every LED, breathe fades it in and out, spin sends a bright segment round the ring, and rainbow turns the hues round it, ignoring color.

speed.description: How fast the effect runs: 2 is twice as fast. (times, 0.1 to 10)
speed.markdownDescription: How fast the effect runs: 2 is twice as fast. (times, 0.1 to 10)

brightness.description: How bright the LEDs are. (%, 0 to 100)
brightness.markdownDescription: How bright the LEDs are. (%, 0 to 100)

source.description: What the ring's `when` rules compare: a sensor key or an expression.
source.markdownDescription: What the ring's `when` rules compare: a sensor key or an expression.

when.description: Changes to make while a condition holds. Every matching rule applies, in order.
when.markdownDescription: Changes to make while a condition holds. Every matching rule applies, in order.

ring.when.description: Ring when rules: Each rule has one condition, which compares the ring's `source`, and changes at least one of color, effect, speed and brightness while it holds. A later rule wins for each key it sets.

above.description: Matches while the ring's source is above this number.
above.markdownDescription: Matches while the ring's source is above this number.

below.description: Matches while the ring's source is below this number.
below.markdownDescription: Matches while the ring's source is below this number.

equals.description: Matches while the ring's source is this number or this text.
equals.markdownDescription: Matches while the ring's source is this number or this text.

stale.description: Matches while the ring's source has no fresh value. It only takes true.
stale.markdownDescription: Matches while the ring's source has no fresh value. It only takes true.

color.description: The LEDs' color. An alpha byte dims it.
color.markdownDescription: The LEDs' color. An alpha byte dims it.

effect.description: static is the color on every LED, breathe fades it in and out, spin sends a bright segment round the ring, and rainbow turns the hues round it, ignoring color.
effect.markdownDescription: static is the color on every LED, breathe fades it in and out, spin sends a bright segment round the ring, and rainbow turns the hues round it, ignoring color.

speed.description: How fast the effect runs: 2 is twice as fast. (times, 0.1 to 10)
speed.markdownDescription: How fast the effect runs: 2 is twice as fast. (times, 0.1 to 10)

brightness.description: How bright the LEDs are. (%, 0 to 100)
brightness.markdownDescription: How bright the LEDs are. (%, 0 to 100)

text.span.description: Text spans: One run of a text or value widget's `spans`. Its style goes over the widget's, and the widget's `when` rules go over every span, so a rule that turns the text red turns every span red. A line is as tall as its largest span, and its spans share the baseline of the tallest.

text.description: The span's text, a template as a text widget's is, where a value widget's {0} is its value. A line break in it starts a new line.
text.markdownDescription: The span's text, a template as a text widget's is, where a value widget's {0} is its value. A line break in it starts a new line.

style.description: The span's letters: a style's name, or a style written in place, with the text keys only. The box keys, such as `fill`, `padding`, `align` and `wrap`, are the widget's: written in place they are an error, and a named style's are left out without a warning.
style.markdownDescription: The span's letters: a style's name, or a style written in place, with the text keys only. The box keys, such as `fill`, `padding`, `align` and `wrap`, are the widget's: written in place they are an error, and a named style's are left out without a warning.

extends.description: Another named style to start from; keys set here override it.
extends.markdownDescription: Another named style to start from; keys set here override it.

font.description: A font installed on this PC, by name, or a .ttf, .otf or .ttc file in the theme folder. Inter is built in.
font.markdownDescription: A font installed on this PC, by name, or a .ttf, .otf or .ttc file in the theme folder. Inter is built in.

weight.description: How heavy text is: 100 to 900, or a name (light 300 to bold 700).
weight.markdownDescription: How heavy text is: 100 to 900, or a name (light 300 to bold 700).

color.description: The text's color, and the filled part of a bar, gauge or graph line when `fill` or `stroke` doesn't set one. A dial's needle and ticks, and a donut's slices, use it when they set no color of their own.
color.markdownDescription: The text's color, and the filled part of a bar, gauge or graph line when `fill` or `stroke` doesn't set one. A dial's needle and ticks, and a donut's slices, use it when they set no color of their own.

shadow.description: A shadow under text, a shape, a gauge's needle, a donut's slices, or an image or video widget's box.
shadow.markdownDescription: A shadow under text, a shape, a gauge's needle, a donut's slices, or an image or video widget's box.

glow.description: A soft glow round text, a shape or a donut's slices.
glow.markdownDescription: A soft glow round text, a shape or a donut's slices.

letter_spacing.description: Space added between the characters of text; below 0 draws them closer. (px, -20 to 100)
letter_spacing.markdownDescription: Space added between the characters of text; below 0 draws them closer. (px, -20 to 100)

text_stroke.description: An outline round each letter, drawn behind the letters' fill.
text_stroke.markdownDescription: An outline round each letter, drawn behind the letters' fill.

text_fill.description: The letters' color or gradient, in place of `color`, which keeps its other jobs. A span's or a rule's `color` doesn't change letters a `text_fill` paints: set `text_fill` there instead. A gradient spans the widget's box, so texts whose boxes line up share one.
text_fill.markdownDescription: The letters' color or gradient, in place of `color`, which keeps its other jobs. A span's or a rule's `color` doesn't change letters a `text_fill` paints: set `text_fill` there instead. A gradient spans the widget's box, so texts whose boxes line up share one.

italic.description: Slanted letters: the font's italic face when an installed font has one, otherwise the letters slanted.
italic.markdownDescription: Slanted letters: the font's italic face when an installed font has one, otherwise the letters slanted.

underline.description: A line under the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.
underline.markdownDescription: A line under the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.

strike.description: A line through the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.
strike.markdownDescription: A line through the text, as long as the text, in the letters' color.

case.description: Changes the text's case once its placeholders are filled in, by the rules of the PC's regional format: `title` capitalises the first letter of every word, am and pm included, and leaves the rest as written.
case.markdownDescription: Changes the text's case once its placeholders are filled in, by the rules of the PC's regional format: `title` capitalises the first letter of every word, am and pm included, and leaves the rest as written.

gauge.needle.description: Gauge needle: A needle from the dial's centre to the value, drawn over the arc and the ticks. It eases with the gauge's `smooth`, takes the style's shadow, and isn't drawn while the value is missing or stale.

width.description: How wide the needle is at the centre; it narrows to a point. (px, at least 1)
width.markdownDescription: How wide the needle is at the centre; it narrows to a point. (px, at least 1)

length.description: How far the needle reaches, as a fraction of the dial's radius. (fraction, 0.1 to 1)
length.markdownDescription: How far the needle reaches, as a fraction of the dial's radius. (fraction, 0.1 to 1)

color.description: The needle's and its hub's color. Left out, it is the style's color.
color.markdownDescription: The needle's and its hub's color. Left out, it is the style's color.

cap.description: The radius of a hub circle over the needle's centre; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0)
cap.markdownDescription: The radius of a hub circle over the needle's centre; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0)

gauge.ticks.description: Gauge ticks: Tick marks round the inside of the arc, from min to max, with the major ticks' values inside them if `labels` is set. Labels use the style's font, size, weight, color and letter spacing; a label that would overlap the one before it is left out.

major.description: How many divisions the scale has: 10 puts a major tick at every tenth of the range, 11 ticks in all, or 10 on a full circle. (1 to 20)
major.markdownDescription: How many divisions the scale has: 10 puts a major tick at every tenth of the range, 11 ticks in all, or 10 on a full circle. (1 to 20)

minor.description: How many minor ticks, half as long, go between each pair of major ticks. (0 to 10)
minor.markdownDescription: How many minor ticks, half as long, go between each pair of major ticks. (0 to 10)

length.description: How long the major ticks are, inwards from the arc. (px, at least 1)
length.markdownDescription: How long the major ticks are, inwards from the arc. (px, at least 1)

width.description: How thick every tick is. (px, at least 1)
width.markdownDescription: How thick every tick is. (px, at least 1)

color.description: The ticks' color. Left out, it is the style's color.
color.markdownDescription: The ticks' color. Left out, it is the style's color.

labels.description: How to write each major tick's value, as a value widget's `format` does, such as "{0:0}". Left out, or false, the ticks have no labels.
labels.markdownDescription: How to write each major tick's value, as a value widget's `format` does, such as "{0:0}". Left out, or false, the ticks have no labels.

graph.grid.description: Graph grid: Horizontal lines across a graph at even steps of its scale, over the track and under the data.

lines.description: How many lines; they split the height into one more band than this. (1 to 20)
lines.markdownDescription: How many lines; they split the height into one more band than this. (1 to 20)

width.description: How thick each line is; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0)
width.markdownDescription: How thick each line is; 0 draws none. (px, at least 0)

graph.series.description: Graph series: One sensor on a graph with several. Its style is layered over the graph's, so the graph can set the line width once and each series its color; box keys such as `track`, `radius` and `opacity` stay the graph's.

source.description: The sensor whose history this series draws: one key, not an expression.
source.markdownDescription: The sensor whose history this series draws: one key, not an expression.

style.description: How this series looks over the graph's own style: a style's name, or one written in place.
style.markdownDescription: How this series looks over the graph's own style: a style's name, or one written in place.

donut.slice.description: Donut slices: One part of a donut's whole. Its style goes over the donut's, and the donut's `when` rules go over every slice.

source.description: The slice's value: a sensor key or an expression. A value of 0 or less takes no room.
source.markdownDescription: The slice's value: a sensor key or an expression. A value of 0 or less takes no room.

label.description: The text the slice's label shows.
label.markdownDescription: The text the slice's label shows.

style.description: The slice's `fill` (default: the style's color), `stroke`, `glow` and `shadow`: a style's name, or a style written in place.
style.markdownDescription: The slice's `fill` (default: the style's color), `stroke`, `glow` and `shadow`: a style's name, or a style written in place.

gradient.description: A paint is a color or a gradient. A gradient is a mapping with `linear:` or `radial:` and two or more colors, and goes wherever a key takes a paint: `fill`, `track`, a stroke's `color` or a fill layer.

gradient.linear.description: Linear gradient: Colors spread in a straight line across the area.

linear.description: The colors, from the start of the line to its end.
linear.markdownDescription: The colors, from the start of the line to its end.

angle.description: The line's direction, clockwise: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom. (degrees)
angle.markdownDescription: The line's direction, clockwise: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom. (degrees)

stops.description: Where each color sits, from 0 (the line's start, or the centre) to 1 (the line's end, or the radius): one per color, each no lower than the one before. Two equal stops make a hard edge. Left out, the colors spread evenly. (fraction, at least 2, each 0 to 1)
stops.markdownDescription: Where each color sits, from 0 (the line's start, or the centre) to 1 (the line's end, or the radius): one per color, each no lower than the one before. Two equal stops make a hard edge. Left out, the colors spread evenly. (fraction, at least 2, each 0 to 1)

gradient.radial.description: Radial gradient: Colors spread in a circle from a centre point outwards.

radial.description: The colors, from the centre out to the radius.
radial.markdownDescription: The colors, from the centre out to the radius.

center.description: Where the circle starts, as [x, y] fractions of the area: [0, 0] is its top-left corner. (fraction, 2, each 0 to 1)
center.markdownDescription: Where the circle starts, as [x, y] fractions of the area: [0, 0] is its top-left corner. (fraction, 2, each 0 to 1)

radius.description: How far the colors reach, as a fraction of half the area's longer side. 3 covers the whole area from any centre, even a corner. (fraction, 0 to 3)
radius.markdownDescription: How far the colors reach, as a fraction of half the area's longer side. 3 covers the whole area from any centre, even a corner. (fraction, 0 to 3)

stops.description: Where each color sits, from 0 (the line's start, or the centre) to 1 (the line's end, or the radius): one per color, each no lower than the one before. Two equal stops make a hard edge. Left out, the colors spread evenly. (fraction, at least 2, each 0 to 1)
stops.markdownDescription: Where each color sits, from 0 (the line's start, or the centre) to 1 (the line's end, or the radius): one per color, each no lower than the one before. Two equal stops make a hard edge. Left out, the colors spread evenly. (fraction, at least 2, each 0 to 1)

layer.description: Each entry of `background:` is one layer, chosen by which of `fill`, `image`, `shader` or `video` it has. Layers cover the whole canvas and are drawn in order, the first at the bottom.

layer.fill.description: Fill layer: A color or gradient.

opacity.description: How solid the layer is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid. (fraction, 0 to 1)
opacity.markdownDescription: How solid the layer is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid. (fraction, 0 to 1)

blend.description: How the layer mixes with the layers under it.
blend.markdownDescription: How the layer mixes with the layers under it.

hidden.description: Leaves the layer off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it.
hidden.markdownDescription: Leaves the layer off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor changing the layer. The screen ignores it.
locked.markdownDescription: Stops the theme editor changing the layer. The screen ignores it.

name.description: What the theme editor's layers list calls the layer: up to 64 characters (VS Code may count an emoji as two), not necessarily unique. The screen ignores it.

fit.description: How the picture fills its box: cover crops to fill it, contain fits inside it, stretch distorts to fill it, and none keeps its own size, centred.
fit.markdownDescription: How the picture fills its box: cover crops to fill it, contain fits inside it, stretch distorts to fill it, and none keeps its own size, centred.

widget.shape.description: Shape: A rectangle, ellipse, line or arc, drawn with its style's `fill`, `stroke` and `opacity`, and a `shadow` and `glow` that follow its outline as they follow text. A `source` and `when` rules can restyle it, so a shape can change color on a condition.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

at.description: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group. (px)
at.markdownDescription: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group. (px)

size.description: The shape's width and height, each at least 1; a line's may be 0 one way, which makes it horizontal or vertical. (px, at least 1, or 0 with `shape: line`)
size.markdownDescription: The shape's width and height, each at least 1; a line's may be 0 one way, which makes it horizontal or vertical. (px, at least 1, or 0 with `shape: line`)

source.description: The value the widget shows, and what its `when` rules compare: a sensor key such as cpu.temp, or an expression. Value, bar and gauge widgets need one; a graph needs one or `series`.
source.markdownDescription: The value the widget shows, and what its `when` rules compare: a sensor key such as cpu.temp, or an expression. Value, bar and gauge widgets need one; a graph needs one or `series`.

style.description: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.
style.markdownDescription: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.

when.description: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.
when.markdownDescription: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.

smooth.description: Eases a value, bar or gauge to a new number over this long; 0 jumps straight there. (ms, 0 to 10000)

shape.description: Which shape: a rect has the style's `radius` corners, an ellipse fills the box, a line runs from the top-left corner to the bottom-right and is drawn by its stroke alone (which it must have), and an arc is a band like a gauge's.
shape.markdownDescription: Which shape: a rect has the style's `radius` corners, an ellipse fills the box, a line runs from the top-left corner to the bottom-right and is drawn by its stroke alone (which it must have), and an arc is a band like a gauge's.

start.description: Where the arc starts, clockwise from 3 o'clock. Only with `shape: arc`. (degrees, -360 to 360)
start.markdownDescription: Where the arc starts, clockwise from 3 o'clock. Only with `shape: arc`. (degrees, -360 to 360)

sweep.description: How far the arc runs from its start; negative runs anticlockwise. It can't be 0. Only with `shape: arc`. (degrees, -360 to 360)
sweep.markdownDescription: How far the arc runs from its start; negative runs anticlockwise. It can't be 0. Only with `shape: arc`. (degrees, -360 to 360)

thickness.description: How thick the arc's band is. The style's `stroke.cap` shapes its ends. Only with `shape: arc`. (px, at least 1)
thickness.markdownDescription: How thick the arc's band is. The style's `stroke.cap` shapes its ends. Only with `shape: arc`. (px, at least 1)

widget.donut.description: Donut: A pie or donut that splits a whole between its slices, in the largest square that fits its box. Each slice's angle is its share of the live slices' total, so a stale slice takes no room and shows only as a notch: its gap, at least 2° wide. Angles are clockwise from 3 o'clock, as a gauge's are. `track` paints the whole ring behind the slices; `fill`, `stroke`, `glow` and `shadow` style every slice, under its own style; and the text style sets the labels.

hole.description: The hole in the middle, as a fraction of the radius; 0 is a pie. (fraction, 0 to 0.9)
hole.markdownDescription: The hole in the middle, as a fraction of the radius; 0 is a pie. (fraction, 0 to 0.9)

start.description: Where the first slice starts: -90 is 12 o'clock, 0 is 3 o'clock. (degrees, -360 to 360)
start.markdownDescription: Where the first slice starts: -90 is 12 o'clock, 0 is 3 o'clock. (degrees, -360 to 360)

gap.description: The space between neighbouring slices. All the gaps together take at most half the circle. (degrees, 0 to 90)
gap.markdownDescription: The space between neighbouring slices. All the gaps together take at most half the circle. (degrees, 0 to 90)

labels.description: Where each slice's label goes: outside the ring, inside it on its middle, or nowhere. A label is left out when its slice is too thin to hold it, when it would overlap the label before it, or, inside, when it would run past the ring. Outside labels stay inside the box across, so leave room beside the ring for them.

format.description: How to write each slice's share of the whole, in percent, after its label, such as "{0:0}%". Left out, labels show only the slice's label.
format.markdownDescription: How to write each slice's share of the whole, in percent, after its label, such as "{0:0}%". Left out, labels show only the slice's label.

slices.description: The parts of the whole, drawn clockwise from start.
slices.markdownDescription: The parts of the whole, drawn clockwise from start.
